name: Paella Paradise
niche: catering / eventos (mobile paella and Latin BBQ catering)
website_check: Google Maps listing shows 'Add website' (no website field). Domain checks for paellaparadise.com, paellaparadisemiami.com and paellaparadisecatering.com all returned NXDOMAIN (confirmed via getent hosts, no DNS record). Web search for 'Paella Paradise' + Miami + catering + Marlon found no official website or social profile, only other unrelated Miami paella caterers (Don Paella, Ale's Paella, Paella VIP). No Instagram handle found.
hours: Open 24 hours (mobile/event catering, booked by appointment; no fixed storefront hours published)

source_of_data.discovery: python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "catering / eventos" --location "Miami Lakes, FL" --min-rating 4.5 --min-reviews 10 -> 1 result, Paella Paradise, 5.0 stars, 24 reviews, no website
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> category 'Caterer', rating 5.0, reviews 24, hours Open 24 hours, no fixed address, phone +1 786-813-2425, 32 Google photos
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 4 unique verbatim 5-star reviews (Noelby De La Hoz, Dylan Correia, rosario garcia, Atomic Event LLC / LORENA MARTINO); owner/chef named 'Marlon' confirmed in a review
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 24 -> 11 unique Google Maps photos, visually curated one by one with the Read tool; 8 kept (2 near-duplicate low-res profile thumbnails and none dropped for quality besides the duplicate)
source_of_data.domain_check: getent hosts paellaparadise.com / paellaparadisemiami.com / paellaparadisecatering.com -> all NXDOMAIN, no resolve. WebSearch for 'Paella Paradise' Miami catering Marlon website/instagram -> no official site or social profile found, only unrelated same-niche competitors.

reviews_verbatim.author: Noelby De La Hoz
reviews_verbatim.text: Hired them for my daughter party. The food was amazing. Everyone at the party enjoyed it!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Dylan Correia
reviews_verbatim.text: Hired them for a birthday party and it was ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!! Food was delicious! Marlon was super friendly and a great guy. Highly recommend

reviews_verbatim.author: LORENA MARTINO
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent presentation and quality. Everything was fresh, well-organized, and delicious. Perfect for sharing. Highly recommended!

reviews_verbatim.author: Atomic Event LLC
reviews_verbatim.text: The food was absolutely delicious! The paella had amazing flavor, the best I've ever had. Highly recommend!

menu_source_note: No published price list found anywhere (no website, no social profile, no menu board visible in any of the 11 Google Maps photos). Per pipeline VARIANTE ADAPTADA, pricing section uses 'se cotiza, escribenos' copy instead of invented prices. Dishes shown in photos (used for service card copy, not pricing): giant paella mixta (chicken, chorizo, shrimp, mussels), pernil/roast pork leg, whole lechon asado, charcuterie/grazing boards, and a tropical pineapple-garnished paella for parties.
service_area_note: No fixed address published (mobile catering, cooks paella on-site at the client's event: photos show setups poolside, at a bar/lounge patio, and at what looks like a corporate or community event). Google Maps lists it under 'Miami Lakes, FL' search area; phone is the only verified contact channel.
gallery_curation_notes: 11 Google Maps photos reviewed individually with the Read tool. 2 were tiny low-resolution duplicate profile thumbnails (270x360, discarded, not usable as tiles). 1 was a 'Screenshot'-tagged image (discarded, not real food photography). Of the 8 remaining: 2 show Marlon (the chef) serving food to guests at a buffet table (clear faces, used only in the about/experience section per the no-selfies-in-gallery rule, never as gallery tiles); the other 6 (paella close-ups, whole roasted pig, charcuterie boards, pernil tray) were used directly as hero/gallery, all food/product focused with no people in frame, no text overlays, no watermarks.
notes: No email, website or social profile found anywhere after a deep search (business name + 'Miami' + 'catering' + 'Marlon' + 'instagram' searches, domain guesses). Only verified public contact channel is the phone number (786) 813-2425, so outreach is phone/text only, outreach: pending_manual. status: staging, not deployed by this routine.
